description: Google Maps Scraper. Extracts data from thousands of Google Maps places and businesses, including reviews, reviewer details, images, contact info, and optional business leads and competitor analysis. Input is either Google Maps URLs or location + search terms.

properties.title: Search Strings
properties.name: searchStringsArray
properties.description: Inputs typed into the Google Maps search bar (e.g. English breakfast, pet shelter). Use distinct, non-duplicated terms for faster processing; when searching for a specific place also fill the location fields.

properties.title: Location
properties.name: locationQuery
properties.description: Defines the location with free text; simple formats work best, e.g. 'city + country' over 'city + country + state'.

properties.title: Max Crawled Places Per Search
properties.name: maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch
properties.description: Expected number of results per search term/category/URL. Larger values take longer.

properties.title: Language
properties.name: language
properties.description: Language used to display result details.

properties.title: Category Filter Words
properties.name: categoryFilterWords
properties.description: Filter places by category; multiple categories can be selected in one field. Note synonyms are different categories (Divorce lawyer / Divorce attorney).

properties.title: Name Matching
properties.name: searchMatching
properties.description: How to match search terms by name: all = name contains every word (e.g. 'chicken' matches places containing chicken); any = name matches the whole search term exactly (e.g. Kentucky Fried Chicken).

properties.title: Minimum Stars
properties.name: placeMinimumStars
properties.description: Only crawl places with a rating equal to or higher than the selected stars; places without reviews are also skipped. Filtering by stars reduces the number of places crawlable per credit spent.

properties.title: Website
properties.name: website
properties.description: Used to exclude places without a website, or the opposite. Disabled by default.

properties.title: Skip Closed Places
properties.name: skipClosedPlaces
properties.description: Skip places permanently/temporarily marked as closed, focusing on currently operating places.

properties.title: Scrape Place Detail Page
properties.name: scrapePlaceDetailPage
properties.description: Crawl each place's detail page individually (requires additional page loads, slower). Enables fields such as reviewsDistribution, openingHours, peopleAlsoSearch, and ensures reviewsCount is scraped.

properties.title: Scrape Reservation Provider
properties.name: scrapeTableReservationProvider
properties.description: Scrape reservation provider data (name, address, email, phone, etc.), present only for restaurants with a blue RESERVE A TABLE button.

properties.title: Scrape Order Online
properties.name: scrapeOrderOnline
properties.description: Scrape the 'Order online' area for restaurants, capturing delivery providers (Uber Eats, DoorDash, etc.) with fees and estimated times.

properties.title: Include Web Results
properties.name: includeWebResults
properties.description: Extract the 'Web results' area at the bottom of each place listing.

properties.title: Scrape Directories
properties.name: scrapeDirectories
properties.description: Some places (e.g. malls) contain multiple businesses; enables scraping the Directory / At this place area.

properties.title: Max Questions
properties.name: maxQuestions
properties.description: Expected number of questions per place. 0 or empty scrapes only the first Q&A; 999 scrapes all. Some fields contain personal data.

properties.title: Scrape Contacts
properties.name: scrapeContacts
properties.description: Enrich Google Maps places with contact info from the business website, including business email and social profiles (Meta, LinkedIn, X, etc.).

properties.title: Social Media Profile Enrichment
properties.name: scrapeSocialMediaProfiles
properties.description: Enable enrichment for found social profiles (followers, bio, posts, verified status, etc.). Boolean object keyed by platform.

properties.title: Max Leads Records
properties.name: maximumLeadsEnrichmentRecords
properties.description: Maximum number of lead records per Google Maps place with a website, including employee name/title/email/phone/LinkedIn and company data. 0 = no leads. Multiplier: 10 x 1000 places will attempt 10000 leads.

properties.title: Leads Departments Filter
properties.name: leadsEnrichmentDepartments
properties.description: Include only the specified departments (e.g. Sales, Marketing, C-Suite). Only applies when leads enrichment is enabled.

properties.title: Verify Leads Emails
properties.name: verifyLeadsEnrichmentEmails
properties.description: Verify each lead's email, adding an emailVerification object per lead. Requires leads enrichment.

properties.title: Max Reviews
properties.name: maxReviews
properties.description: Expected number of reviews per place.

properties.title: Reviews Start Date
properties.name: reviewsStartDate
properties.description: Absolute date (e.g. 2024-05-03) or relative date (e.g. 8 days, 3 months).

properties.title: Reviews Sort
properties.name: reviewsSort
properties.description: Review sorting. Allowed values per original actor docs (e.g. newest / mostRelevant / oldest).

properties.title: Reviews Filter String
properties.name: reviewsFilterString
properties.description: Input a keyword to scrape only reviews containing it; leave empty to scrape all reviews.

properties.title: Reviews Origin
properties.name: reviewsOrigin
properties.description: Scrape all reviews (Google, Tripadvisor, etc.) or only Google reviews.

properties.title: Scrape Reviewer Personal Data
properties.name: scrapeReviewsPersonalData
properties.description: Fetch reviewers' personal data (ID, name, URL, avatar URL) and review URLs. Some fields contain personal data; comply with relevant regulations.

properties.title: Max Images
properties.name: maxImages
properties.description: Expected number of images per place.

properties.title: Scrape Image Authors
properties.name: scrapeImageAuthors
properties.description: Attach the author name to each image. Slower due to per-image info fetching.

properties.title: Enable Competitor Analysis
properties.name: enableCompetitorAnalysis
properties.description: Run AI competitor analysis on scraped top places; reports stored in the competitorAnalysis dataset.

properties.title: Max Competitors to Analyze
properties.name: maxCompetitorsToAnalyze
properties.description: Total places to crawl and analyze across all searches, capped at 100; directly bounds total analysis cost.

properties.title: Country
properties.name: countryCode
properties.description: Country of data extraction execution, e.g. United States.

properties.title: City
properties.name: city
properties.description: City of data extraction execution, e.g. Pittsburgh. Do not include state or country names.

properties.title: State
properties.name: state
properties.description: State of data extraction execution, e.g. Massachusetts (mainly for US addresses).

properties.title: County
properties.name: county
properties.description: County of data extraction execution; note counties represent different administrative areas per country.

properties.title: Postal Code
properties.name: postalCode
properties.description: Postal code of data extraction execution, e.g. 10001. Combine only with country, not with city.

properties.title: Custom Geolocation
properties.name: customGeolocation
properties.description: Precisely bound the search area with coordinates when other location params do not apply (GeoJSON: Polygon / MultiPolygon / Circle / Point + radiusKm; coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order).

properties.title: Start URLs
properties.name: startUrls
properties.description: List of Google Maps search URLs, up to 300 results per URL. URLs must contain google.com/maps/; non-standard formats like cid are supported.

properties.title: Place IDs
properties.name: placeIds
properties.description: List of place IDs in the format ChIJreV9aqYWdkgROM_boL6YbwA (27 characters).

properties.title: Scrape All Map Places
properties.name: allPlacesNoSearchAction
properties.description: Extract all visible places on the map. Auto-selects an appropriate zoom level; can be overridden with zoom (1-21).
